original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-2-fibre-product-general}
Let $S$ be a scheme contained in $\Sch_{fppf}$.
Let $\mathcal{Z}$ be a stack in groupoids over $(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$
whose diagonal is representable by algebraic spaces.
Let $\mathcal{X}$, $\mathcal{Y}$ be algebraic stacks over $S$.
Let $f : \mathcal{X} \to \mathcal{Z}$, $g : \mathcal{Y} \to \mathcal{Z}$
be $1$-morphisms of stacks in groupoids. Then the $2$-fibre product
$\mathcal{X} \times_{f, \mathcal{Z}, g} \mathcal{Y}$ is an algebraic stack.

A $2$-fibre product $\mathcal X\times_\mathcal Z\mathcal Y$ has objects over a test scheme $T$ given by triples $(x,y,\alpha)$ with $x\in\mathcal X_T$, $y\in\mathcal Y_T$ and an isomorphism $\alpha:f(x)\xrightarrow{\sim}g(y)$ in $\mathcal Z_T$. A morphism $f:\mathcal X\to\mathcal Y$ of categories fibred in groupoids is representable by algebraic spaces if all such 2-base changes along maps from schemes are stacks associated with algebraic spaces. A surjective smooth atlas of an algebraic stack is a smooth representable 1-morphism $(\Sch/U)_{fppf}\to\mathcal X$ locally surjective on objects in the smooth topology.

original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-2-fibre-product}
Let $S$ be a scheme contained in $\Sch_{fppf}$.
Let $\mathcal{X}, \mathcal{Y}, \mathcal{Z}$ be algebraic stacks over $S$.
Let $f : \mathcal{X} \to \mathcal{Z}$, $g : \mathcal{Y} \to \mathcal{Z}$
be $1$-morphisms of algebraic stacks. Then the $2$-fibre product
$\mathcal{X} \times_{f, \mathcal{Z}, g} \mathcal{Y}$ is an algebraic stack.
It is also the $2$-fibre product in the $2$-category of algebraic stacks
over $(\Sch/S)_{fppf}$.
